interviews.title: He Built India's Biggest Car Selling & Purchasing Platform
interviews.description: Cars24 banane, leadership, hiring, scaling, aur Mahendra Singh Dhoni se mile lessons par seedhi baat.

interviews.title: Meet Cars24 Founder
interviews.description: Cars24 ke shuru ke safar, ambition, aur uncertainty mein build karne ke liye zaruri soch par baat.

interviews.title: How Cars24 CEO, Vikram Chopra Built a Rs 27,000 cr used car startup
interviews.description: Cars24 ki growth, used-car market, company ki shuruaat, aur Raebareli se ek badi company banane ke safar par detail mein baat.

interviews.title: Playing the long game: what it takes to build generation defining companies
interviews.description: Tikau companies banane par panel — Vikram Chopra ke saath Asish Mohapatra aur Varun Alagh.

elsewhere.title: What You're Actually Paying For When You Buy a Used Car Online
elsewhere.description: Pricing, trust, aur ye ki buyers jab used-car platforms ko local dealers se compare karte hain toh sach mein kya dekh rahe hote hain — ek seedha argument.

elsewhere.title: How we use AI will determine our success
elsewhere.description: Cars24 ki soch ki seedhi baat — appraisal quality, pricing accuracy, aur AI-driven learning hi decide karegi used-car market mein kaun jeeta hai.

elsewhere.title: The world is in a bad place this year, but I need to take a long-term view
elsewhere.description: Funding winter navigate karna, burn kam karna, aur business ko kai dashakon ki nazar se dekhkar decisions lena — isi par baat.

elsewhere.title: 'Political Will' Is India's Biggest Failure in Air Pollution Control
elsewhere.description: Pollution par uncomfortable public policy action ka argument — chahe wo car industry ke turant hit ke khilaf hi kyun na jaye.

elsewhere.title: Rising Strong: The Art of Failing Forward
elsewhere.description: Failure, resilience, aur girane ke baad phir uthne ke liye jo emotional kaam karna padta hai — uspar chhoti si soch.

elsewhere.title: Embracing Discomfort for Growth
elsewhere.description: Takleef ko deliberately chunna — growth, ambition, aur behtar judgment ki shart ke roop mein.

flatland.title: Flatland
flatland.description: Ek flatter, faster Cars24 ke liye operating note: builder ownership, open information, AI-native kaam, aur hierarchy se zyada clarity.

values.title: Hamari Values
values.description: Cars24 ke kaam karne ke paanch values: customer love, ownership, sach bolna, high standards, aur kaam ke zariye behtar insaan banana.

mobility-ownership-trust.title: Mobility, Ownership, aur Trust
mobility-ownership-trust.description: Messy assets itne bharosemand kaise bante hain ki log unhe khareed sake, finance kar sake, rakh sake, aur use kar sake.

ai-work-company-design.title: Organization, AI, aur Company Design
ai-work-company-design.description: Companies kaise seekhti hain, pressure mein kaisi tikti hain, aur jab context sasta ho jaaye aur builders loops jaldi close karne lage toh khud ko kaise redesign karti hain.

judgment-desire-human-nature.title: Judgment, Chahat, aur Insaani Fitrat
judgment-desire-human-nature.description: Hum apni khud ki chahat ko kyun galat samajhte hain, doosron ko kyun misread karte hain, aur rozana ki zindagi mein kaunsi invisible psychological machinery saath leke chalte hain.
